{{Short description|Norwegian physicist}}
'''Bjørn Gjevik''' (born 30 March 1939) is a Norwegian physicist.

He hails from [[Hitra Municipality]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=A.K. |date=30 March 1989 |title=Med havet som forskningsfelt |work=Aftenposten |page=14 |language=Norwegian}}</ref> He took the [[dr.philos.]] degree in 1972 and became a professor of [[hydrodynamics]] at the [[University of Oslo]] in 1977.<ref name="snl">{{Store norske leksikon|Bjørn_Gjevik|Bjørn Gjevik|2025-01-25|Lindstrøm|Tom|2024-11-26}}</ref> He is a fellow of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]].<ref name="ntb">{{Cite news |date=11 March 2009 |title=70 år 30. mars: Professor Bjørn Gjevik |language=Norwegian |agency=Norwegian News Agency}}</ref>

He resides at [[Grav, Norway|Grav]].<ref name="ntb" />
